notes.title: 🔥 Major Updates for Steam Next Fest! 🔥
notes.content:
✨ New Additions & Improvements

New Overworld Mobs!
[list]
[*] Each player will now have 6 overworld mobs spawned near them.
[*] 70% chance to spawn a Chicken, 30% chance to spawn a Boar.
[*] If a player is not in the same chunk as a mob, it will respawn in 5 seconds.
[*] If a player moves 3 chunks away, a new set of mobs can spawn.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289453/8274ff2b120844c792dc14d099463f067bfa1f4c.png[/img]
Portal Activation Feedback
[list]
[*] Added visual feedback to indicate when a portal is activated.
[*] Unactivated portals now have a distinct state for better clarity.
[/list]
Moving Cloud Shadows
[list]
[*] To add more depth to the overworld, we’ve introduced basic moving cloud shadows!
[/list]
---
🐛 Bug Fixes & QoL Updates
[b]Hel Mob Spawning Fix[/b]
[list]
[*] Mobs in Hel should no longer spawn inside decorative objects (e.g., rocks, structures).
[*] This fixes an issue where mobs would become invisible, blocking wave progression.
[/list]
[b]Crafting System Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Inventory Full? Crafted items will no longer disappear when claimed.
[*] If the inventory is full, items will either drop to the ground or show a warning message.
[*] Crafting Table "Cancel" Button Fixed! It now properly stops crafting mid-progress.
[*] Crafting Bench Glitch Fixed
[*] Selecting two crafting benches from inventory no longer causes the blueprint to get stuck on the cursor.
[/list]

[b]Hel Boons Now Reset Properly[/b]

[list]
[*] Hel Boons from a previous run will no longer carry over into a new run.
[*] This prevents unintended stacking effects that could break game balance.
[/list]

[b]ESC Key & UI Focus Fix[/b]

[list]
[*] The ESC key should now properly close menus, even after UI focus changes.
[/list]

---

[b]💬 Join the Community![/b]
Want to chat with the devs and other players? Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/QqY7zAzvhn

We can't wait for you to try out these updates during Steam Next Fest! Let us know what you think and keep that feedback coming. See you in Hel! 🔥
